reason: A policy violation already occurred in the visible prefix: the assistant executed both a pending-order item modification and a shipping-address modification after only one confirmation. The policy says item modifications can only be called once and, once that action is taken, the agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore. Also, the assistant invoked two database-updating tool calls separately after confirming only the item change, despite the need to list action details and obtain explicit confirmation before each updating action.
